verdict.rationale: Pilot is a SaaS bookkeeping, tax and CFO service, so official SDKs are a fair axis for it. The evidence pack shows no SDK, API or developer documentation. Probes for OpenAPI specs all returned 404, and the integrations cited are third-party connections (Stripe, Gusto, Bill.com) rather than SDKs a user can build against.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can build against official SDKs
